Half-open round assignment; victim looked up in final first-write map; event tick exported only as rounded relative t; reported duration rounded and not clamped to round.
Blind serialization has t/duration/steamId/flasherSteamId, no canonical tick.
Float conversion is strict variant conversion; no finite-value guard.
Runtime descriptors supply key names/types. This source does not statically establish player_blind-specific keys.
